Package pl.rentathing.Rental.Repository

Interface RentalRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Rental,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Rental,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Rental,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Rental,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Rental,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Rental>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Rental,Long>
@Repository public interface RentalRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Rental,Long>
RentalRepository is a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Rental entities. It provides methods to perform CRUD operations and custom query methods for retrieving rentals based on filters and specific criteria.

  • Method Details

    • existsConflictWithBuffer

      @Query(" SELECT COUNT(r) > 0 FROM Rental r\n WHERE r.item.id = :itemId\n AND (\n (r.status IN (\'NEW\', \'PENDING\', \'ACTIVE\', \'OVERDUE\') AND r.startDateTime <= :end AND r.endDateTime >= :start)\n )\n") boolean existsConflictWithBuffer(@Param("itemId") Long itemId, @Param("start") LocalDateTime start, @Param("end") LocalDateTime end)
      Checks if there is a conflict within the buffer period for a specific item rental. A conflict occurs if there is an existing rental with an overlapping date range where the rental has a status of NEW, PENDING, ACTIVE, or OVERDUE.
      Parameters:
      itemId - the ID of the item to check for rental conflicts
      start - the start date and time of the buffer period to check
      end - the end date and time of the buffer period to check
      Returns:
      true if a rental conflict exists for the given item and date range, false otherwise

    • findFilteredRentals

      @Query("SELECT r FROM Rental r WHERE r.user = :user AND (:search IS NULL OR LOWER(r.item.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :search, \'%\')) OR LOWER(CAST(r.id as String)) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :search, \'%\'))) AND (:status IS NULL OR r.status = :status)") org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Rental> findFilteredRentals(@Param("user") User user, @Param("search") String search, @Param("status") RentalStatus status, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of rentals filtered by user, search query, and status.
      Parameters:
      user - the user associated with the rentals
      search - the search query to filter rentals by item title or rental ID, case-insensitive; can be null
      status - the rental status to filter by; can be null
      pageable - the pagination information
      Returns:
      a page of rentals that match the specified filters

    • findAllFiltered

      @Query("SELECT r FROM Rental r LEFT JOIN r.item i LEFT JOIN r.user u WHERE (:search IS NULL OR LOWER(i.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :search, \'%\')) OR LOWER(u.lastName) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :search, \'%\')) OR CAST(r.id AS string) LIKE CONCAT(\'%\', :search, \'%\')) AND (:status IS NULL OR r.status = :status) AND (:category IS NULL OR i.category.name = :category) AND (:returnDate IS NULL OR CAST(r.endDateTime AS date) = :returnDate)") org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Rental> findAllFiltered(@Param("search") String search, @Param("status") RentalStatus status, @Param("category") String category, @Param("returnDate") LocalDate returnDate, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of rentals that match the specified filters. The filters can include a search query, rental status, item category, and return date. Any filter parameter can be null, indicating that it should be ignored in the filtering.
      Parameters:
      search - the search query to filter rentals by item title, user last name, or rental ID. Filters are case-insensitive. Can be null.
      status - the rental status to filter by. Can be null.
      category - the category name of the item to filter by. Can be null.
      returnDate - the specific return date to filter by in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. Can be null.
      pageable - the pagination information, containing page number and size.
      Returns:
      a Page containing rentals that match the given filters.

    • findByIdWithDetails

      @Query("SELECT r FROM Rental r JOIN FETCH r.item i JOIN FETCH i.category JOIN FETCH r.user u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.address WHERE r.id = :id") Optional<Rental> findByIdWithDetails(@Param("id") Long id)
      Retrieves a rental by its ID along with all associated details, including the item, item's category, user, and user's address (if available).
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the rental to be retrieved
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the rental with all associated details if it exists; otherwise, an empty Optional

    • findAllByStartDateTimeBetweenWithDetails

      @Query("SELECT r FROM Rental r JOIN FETCH r.item i JOIN FETCH r.user u WHERE r.startDateTime >= :start AND r.startDateTime <= :end ORDER BY r.startDateTime DESC") List<Rental> findAllByStartDateTimeBetweenWithDetails(@Param("start") LocalDateTime start, @Param("end") LocalDateTime end)
      Retrieves a list of Rental entities that have start date and time within the specified range. The query joins the Rental entity with the associated Item and User entities and retrieves all relevant details. The results are ordered in descending order by the start date and time.
      Parameters:
      start - the starting point of the date and time range for filtering rentals
      end - the ending point of the date and time range for filtering rentals
      Returns:
      a list of Rental entities that match the specified date and time range with detailed information
